requirements.requirement: The system must include a normalized_recency_score field for each clinical trial in the evaluation API response.
The system must include last_update_date in the clinical trial response payload when available.
The system must include days_since_update in the clinical trial response payload when calculable.
The system must include a missing_data_flag field indicating absence or invalidity of update data.
The system must ensure recency fields are present for every trial object returned, even if values are null.
The system must preserve existing clinical trial response structure and append recency fields without breaking backward compatibility.
The system must source recency scoring values from the recency scoring logic implemented in EVAL-CT-M6-S2.
The system must include recency metadata in a consistent schema aligned with the contract defined in EVAL-CT-M6-S1.
The system must return recency scores for all trials in a single API response without requiring additional downstream calls.
The system must ensure recency scores are numeric and normalized within the defined range (e.g., 0 to 1).
The system must handle missing last_update_date by setting normalized_recency_score to null and missing_data_flag to true.
The system must handle malformed last_update_date values without failing the API response and must set missing_data_flag to true.
The system must ensure the evaluate care facade aggregates recency data for each trial before returning the final response.
The system must expose recency fields in a way that downstream scoring components can consume without transformation.
The system must ensure API response latency does not increase beyond acceptable thresholds due to recency enrichment.
The system must ensure LLM consumers receive explicit recency fields rather than requiring inference from raw dates.
The system must ensure LLM-readable field names are semantically clear (e.g., normalized_recency_score, days_since_update).
The system must ensure recency metadata is consistently ordered and structured across all trial objects for predictable LLM parsing.
The system must ensure no ambiguous or duplicate recency-related fields are present in the API response.
The system must ensure recency scores are interpretable by LLMs without requiring additional context or lookup tables.
